Select IC50 activities in nM for compounds tested against human TYK2. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, and compound_records. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Retrieve publication reference using COALESCE(docs.doi, docs.pubmed_id) aliased as pubmed_id_or_doi. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
